personText: We are blessed to have so many wonderful dog parks in Dane County. Prairie Moraine is probably the largest, which gives us a great opportunity to get some exercise, while also walking Izzy.
dogText: This is a BIG dog park, with different terrain. It gives Izzy the opportunity to tire herself out.
walkText: Off-leash, large area and different terrains make it interesting for dogs.

imageDescript: Wide open area for dogs to ''do their business''.
personText: A dog has to do what a dog has to do.
dogText: A wide open area allows a dog to ''have some privacy''.
walkText: A wide open space allows a dog to find an area away from other dogs, so they don't feel vulnerable when doing their business.

imageDescript: Trash cans to throw dog waste
personText: We always ''do the right thing'' by cleaning up after Izzy. Being able to do so makes us feel like better citizens.
dogText: I don't really think Izzy cares where we dispose of her poop!
walkText: Having trash cans around to dispose of waste is a big plus!

imageDescript: Wide open space with different terrains and hills
personText: We love being outdoors and walking/hiking. A large, diverse dog park such as Prairie Moraine allows us to enjoy that, while walking Izzy too.
dogText: Izzy loves to roam and run. Providing such a space as this allows her to do whatever she's feeling.

imageDescript: Off-leash dog parks allow dogs to socialize on their terms
personText: An at ease dog makes an at ease dog owner.
dogText: An off-leash dog is a more confident dog. Not all dogs are great at ''playing well with others''. Not being encumbered by a leash gives them an out.
walkText: Dogs just want to be free...

personText: It gets hot out there! If walking the full ~2-miles, we need some shade.
dogText: Izzy is the most heat intolerant dog we've ever owned. She will seek out shade, and generally plop down in the shaded grass to cool down.
walkText: Dogs can suffer heat exhaustion as well as humans. It is extremely important to have ''natural cooling stations''.

dogText: I have to assume that Izzy likes variety too.
walkText: Mixing it up provides more mental stimulation.
